# SOR Elicitation Checklist

Ask only questions needed to proceed. Record supplied answers as user-provided input and preserve unknowns as owned questions or assumptions.

## Purpose and Scope

- What problem, opportunity, users, outcomes, success measures, and boundaries define the work?
- What is explicitly out of scope, and which environments, integrations, and lifecycle stages are affected?

## Governance and Evidence

- Who sponsors, funds, owns, delivers, operates, assures, and accepts the result?
- Which sources are authoritative, and who may approve scope, exceptions, baseline, and change?

## Capabilities and Constraints

- Which user journeys, capabilities, service outcomes, business rules, interfaces, and dependencies are mandatory?
- Which legal, regulatory, commercial, location, schedule, interoperability, or other user constraints are evidenced? Record any technical solution information separately from the SOR.

## Security, Privacy, and Quality

- Which data classifications, access, audit, retention, residency, safety, accessibility, and assurance obligations apply?
- What performance, capacity, availability, durability, recovery, continuity, support, maintainability, and observability outcomes are required?

## Operations and Commercial Control

- Who owns support, incidents, changes, runbooks, patching, backups, access reviews, cost allocation, transition, and retirement?
- What budget, whole-life cost, licensing, supplier, warranty, exit, or procurement needs are applicable?

## Delivery and Acceptance

- What delivery evidence, test environments, pass criteria, documentation, training, transition, sign-offs, and exception process are required?
- What evidence proves each requirement is met, and who accepts it?
